description:
PERMANENTLY DESTROYS a branch and anything written to it since it was created. The source database is untouched.

Only works on branches — it refuses the cluster's default database, which has to be removed with delete_instance instead.

confirm_name.description: The exact instance name, as a guard against acting on the wrong one. Call get_instance first and copy it from there.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

name: delete_branch
title: Delete a branch
